title: Variables & values
outcome: Represent, convert and update small pieces of communications data.

steps.title: 1. Know the contract
steps.text: The checker supplies a different value as data for every case. Write statements assigning the required answer to result. Do not replace data with the sample input. You do not need to define a function yet.

steps.title: 2. Names and types
steps.text: Assignment binds a name to an object. Numeric text is not a number. Use int or float intentionally; keep display formatting separate from calculation.
steps.code:
count_text = "12"
count = int(count_text)
label = f"{count} ports"

steps.title: 3. Trace updates
steps.text: The right-hand expression is evaluated before assignment. Augmented assignment updates a value; do not confuse = with ==.

steps.title: 4. Copies and shared objects
steps.text: Two names can refer to the same list. A shallow list copy separates the outer list, but not nested mutable objects. Use deepcopy only when that is the required behavior.

steps.title: 5. Practice, check, apply
steps.text: Complete the 15 varied tasks. Then solve three differently worded coding checks without hints. The supplied tests are visible practice evidence, not secure exam questions.
